scope: 8 个真实回环 HTTP 请求，同时核对业务副作用
notCovered: nested REQUIRES_NEW pool-exhaustion scenario (diagram is mechanism inference)
Servlet async dispatch, TLS, reverse proxy, HTTP/2, browser disconnect
standalone JVM SIGTERM or orchestration-platform draining
identity, inventory, payment, idempotency, broker/event handoff
website browser rendering/accessibility (separate site QA, outside this experiment)
reviewFindingsClosed: HTTP 状态、媒体类型和语义响应体断言已通过错误实现回归验证
容器销毁事件与资源归还断言已补足并通过独立复核

reviewSummary.baseline: Freshly extracted R2 source passed the complete lifecycle, pool and real loopback HTTP suite in its fixed environment.
negativeControls: Missing success body rejected by complete JSON assertion
Wrong public error contract rejected by exact error-code assertion
Missing consumer destruction rejected by exactly-once event assertion
reviewSummary.limits: Targeted regression evidence; not exhaustive correctness or production reliability.
reviewSummary.publicEvidence: The same source ZIP contains VERIFICATION.md, SOURCE_SHA256SUMS and sanitized verification/negative-control output.
